t: You're at 28 to 44 Gloucester Terrace in Westminster, a building where the singer and actress Florence St. John both lived and died. Born Margaret Florence Greig, she took her stage name and became famous in the late Victorian and Edwardian years. She was known for her roles in operetta, musical burlesque, music hall and opera, and later in comic plays. She lived from 1855 to 1912, so this is a place connected with the end of a long and varied stage career.
